name: @agentic-toolkit/bitbag
description: bitbag — his persona, voice, avatar rig, and chat surface. Mounts on any site that links @agenticdevelopertoolkit.

scripts.build: tsup && pnpm run build:types && pnpm run build:css

//devDependencies: The four @agenticdevelopertoolkit/* entries are peer deps above — consumers supply them; these `link:`s exist only so this package can build and test itself. They target THIS repo's own submodule at external/adhsdk, so a `git clone --recursive` builds with no sibling checkout anywhere on disk. They used to climb six levels OUT of the repo to a sibling clone, which resolved inside adh (both toolkits sit side by side under frontend/src/external/) and nowhere else by guarantee. `link:` rather than workspace:* because that toolkit is a SEPARATE pnpm workspace and pnpm cannot nest workspaces. bitbag is the one package that owns this crossing on purpose: everything else in this repo reaches persona vocabulary through bitbag's re-exports, which is what keeps the persona toolkit out of every other consumer's shipped graph.
